content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Office REIT leasing workspace to corporate tenants; it does not build and sell homes to buyers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes in planned communities, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage financing for buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time buyers, with mortgage and title services for buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots and sells them to homebuilders; it does not build homes for consumers."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in Sunbelt markets, with mortgage financing."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with mortgage, title and insurance services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title, mortgage guaranty and general insurance; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and townhome homes to first-time and move-up buyers via its own sales centers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Title insurer and data software provider; it does not build homes, though it serves homebuyers' transactions."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Diversified land, hotel, club and timber company; its homebuilding is minor versus resort and hospitality operations."}]}
